messages:
samir: Morning — noticed a spike in GPU nodes failing to join in ap-southeast-1 starting ~08:12. ~40% of pending joins errored with 'kms:DecryptAccessDenied'.

jess: Saw the grafana spike and warm-pool drain. Autoscaler keeps launching but nodes never finish bootstrap.

marta: Sample bootstrap log snippet: ```
2026-03-23T08:13:02Z node-init: decrypt failed: kms:DecryptAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:...
2026-03-23T08:13:03Z node-init: fallback keystore try -> connection timed out
2026-03-23T08:13:05Z gpu-agent: failed to register with allocator: auth error
```

infra-bot: [alert] GPU-POOL-JOIN-Failure threshold exceeded in ap-southeast-1 (45m). Incident created: INC-178123.

samir: My quick hypothesis — the recent firewall/egress tightening for audit-forwarding rolled out at ~07:55, which may have ACL'd the keystore endpoints we use for node decryption.

jess: @alessio (security) — any egress ACL changes around that time that could block keystore?

alessio: Yep, we pushed an allowlist for audit-shipper egress to reduce noise at 07:55. It looks like the keystore FQDNs were omitted from the allowlist in the ap-southeast policy. Rolling a partial rollback now.

marta: Temporary mitigation that worked in staging: add NAT egress to keystore CIDR so bootstrap can decrypt while security does a proper patch. I just pushed a one-off NAT rule and a few nodes are finishing join.

samir: Good. FYI this means we'll keep higher warm-pool churn / prewarm until cluster stabilizes — estimate ~200 GPU-hours extra over next 24h. We should call that out to finance.

jess: Action items: 1) @alessio rollback the allowlist or add keystore FQDNs to it (in progress) 2) infra to revert the temp NAT rule when stable (marta) 3) create postmortem and include cost delta (samir/jess) 4) make keystore endpoints explicit in future audit allowlists.

alessio: Rollback started — staging and canary done, starting regional cutover for ap-southeast. ETA ~10m. Will update INC-178123.

oncall-rota: Acknowledged. Monitoring rejoin rate. Please @mention if joins stop recovering by +15m.

samir: If rollback fails, we'll fail open for keystore and schedule a security follow-up; don't want long GPU starvation. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks all — ping once joins >90% and autoscaler stabilizes.

marta: Noted. I'll capture the boot logs and add to the incident ticket.

infra-bot: [update] Incident INC-178123 updated: rollback started by alessio at 08:28.
